scripts.connector:build: cd connector && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o dist/Munim.exe ./cmd/lkp-agent
scripts.app:clear: corepack pnpm --filter mobile exec expo start --clear
scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,3001,8081 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }" && wsl -e bash -lic "pkill -f 'node src/index.js' || true"
scripts.app:dev: corepack pnpm --filter mobile exec expo start --dev-client
scripts.app:build: cd apps/mobile && npx --yes eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile development
scripts.apk: cd apps/mobile && npx --yes eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.app:usb:clean: cd apps/mobile && npx expo prebuild --clean --platform android && npx expo run:android
